properties.name: description
properties.comment: The text the dialog shows the user: above the tree on Windows, as the title elsewhere. Empty gives the host's own. Valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_dialog_text(incoming, "FolderBrowserDialog description must be valid UTF-8 without NUL");

properties.name: initial_directory
properties.comment: The folder the dialog starts in when no folder is selected; empty lets the host choose. Valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_dialog_text(incoming, "FolderBrowserDialog initial directory must be valid UTF-8 without NUL");

properties.name: selected_path
properties.comment: The chosen folder, or empty. A folder set here before the dialog is shown is the one it starts in; an accepted show_dialog moves it. Valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
hand: a view onto selected_path_, which show_dialog moves; write_view validates

not_properties.name: status
not_properties.reason: the host's answer to the last show_dialog; read-only

not_properties.name: reset
not_properties.reason: restores every setting; a method writing each cell
